title: Interrupt Controller
constraints: Eight **edge-triggered** sources: a rising edge on `irq_in[i]` (compared with its value at the previous clock edge) sets the sticky bit `pending[i]`.

`mask` register (1 = enabled), written from `mask_data` on an edge with `mask_we`. `irq = |(pending & mask)`. `id` = index of the **lowest-numbered** pending and enabled source (0 when none). Both combinational.

An edge with `ack` clears `pending[id]` of the current `id` (only if `irq` is 1). If the same source has a new rising edge on that edge, set wins. Synchronous reset clears pending, mask, and the previous-input register.
hints: A priority encoder over `pending & mask` gives `id`, and a one-hot of `id` gives `clr`.
Masked sources still latch their edges: unmasking later raises `irq` immediately.
